verdict.rationale: Adyen's relayed authorisation sends a webhook with transaction data for each authorisation request, and your server approves or refuses it in real time. The docs set a 2000 ms response budget and a configurable fallback (default approval or default refusal) if you don't reply in time; the endpoint is set up under Customer Area > Financial products > Relayed authorisation. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of latency and fallback behavior, and details of the response payload format.
